about: Santa in the Cabin is a longstanding Hudson tradition hosted by the Rotary Club of Hudson in the heart of the downtown.
This year it takes place on Saturday, December 5, 2026, between 9 AM and 3 PM.
The City of Hudson lists it as a free event on the Hudson Happenings community calendar.
Santa and Mrs. Claus roll up to the Scout Cabin on a fire truck at 9 AM to start the day.
Inside, the beautifully restored cabin is dressed with holiday decor and a glowing fireplace for family portraits.
Elves are on hand to help with photos, and parents are encouraged to bring their own camera.
To keep lines short, the Rotary Club uses a ticket system with hourly visit slots for 20 families at a time.
A total of 120 free tickets are given out starting at 8 AM at the Gazebo, first come, first served, and each ticket carries an assigned time.
Families should arrive at the cabin at their ticket time and enter through the rear of the building, where parking is available.
Complimentary hot chocolate and candy canes are served outside the cabin.
The Scout Cabin sits at the corner of Streetsboro Street in the village center, close to the other Hudson holiday stops.
